verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local and cloud model runtime with an API and launchers for third-party coding agents. It does not host user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Ollama shipping its own automation or workflow feature. Integrations such as OpenClaw and `ollama launch` hand that work to external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
